about:
Andersen Wrecking Co., Inc. has operated from Kearney, Nebraska since 1937. Founded as a family-owned auto wrecking and recycling yard, the business has grown into one of the Midwest’s leading recyclers serving central Nebraska and beyond. Since its founding, the company has provided the region with high-quality new, aftermarket, and recycled auto parts.

The company maintains an extensive inventory searchable nationwide through the Car-Part Interchange system, offering components ranging from wiring harnesses and differential assemblies to diesel particulate filters and bumper assemblies. It also purchases and recycles ferrous and non-ferrous metal salvage, providing dismantling and metal recycling services.

Customers include automotive repair shops, collision centers, individual vehicle owners, and scrap metal buyers across the Midwest. The business serves both retail and wholesale customers, with warranty options available. The company’s automotive professionals assist with locating specific parts, whether for foreign or domestic vehicles.

Andersen Wrecking emphasizes its long-standing presence as a leading recycler, combining a large parts inventory with nationwide search capability and a commitment to dependable recycled components.
